title: fetching mail
creator: simon.mrochen
content: Hey, I changed the fetching mail settings multiple times cause I wanted to fetch more mails than previous. But this lead to nothing... It does not lead to the download of older Mails. Even in the case of local folder size: all Messages and sync messages: from last 6 months no Mails older than some days appear. My Thunderbird-Mobile version is 23.0, the problem was also apparent before the update in version 22.0. My operating system is Android 15
